Subject: Post-demo: SOC 2 & Pen Test report + vuln management next steps

Hi Alex — thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- SOC 2: Redwood is currently SOC 2 Type II in scope for our hosted product (report available). I can share the report link and a short summary.
- Pen test: We can provide a pen-test summary publicly; the full report can be shared under NDA/controlled access.
- Vulnerability management: Our standard cadence is weekly automated scanning + quarterly full external tests, with critical findings triaged within 72 hours and remediation SLAs we can align on.

Next steps I suggest:
1) I’ll send our SOC 2 report link and a high-level pen-test summary (attachment).
2) If you want the full pen-test report, we can provide it under an NDA — Marissa will coordinate with you on procurement steps.
3) Rishi will share our vuln management process and disclosure policy so you can confirm it meets FinHealth’s requirements (HIPAA/GDPR considerations).
4) Schedule a short follow-up with your security lead to go through the questionnaire and any gaps.

Thanks — happy to jump back on a call if useful.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Carter <alex.carter@finhealth.com>

Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 13:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo: SOC 2 & Pen Test report + vuln management next steps

Hi Stephanie — appreciate the recap. A few clarifying Qs from our side: 

1) For SOC 2, can you confirm the period covered and whether the report includes the Redwood Private offering (we host some sensitive workloads)?
2) For the pen test: does Redwood share the full report with customers, or only an executive summary? If full reports are shared, we’ll need to route it through our procurement/legal and likely require an NDA.
3) On vulnerability management: can you send the SLA for remediation windows and whether you provide proof-of-fix for critical/high findings? Also need to confirm scanning cadence and whether you perform authenticated scans for our use case.

We’ve attached our vendor security questionnaire to get the process started — would you please confirm next steps and an owner on your side?

Thanks — I’ll loop in our security team if needed.

Best,
Alex Carter
Head of Security Programs
FinHealth Inc.

[Attachment: FinHealth_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alex Carter <alex.carter@finhealth.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: SOC 2 & Pen Test report + vuln management next steps

Hi Alex — thanks for the questions. Quick answers below and attached references: 

- SOC 2: Our current Type II report covers 01/01/2025 - 12/31/2025 and includes Hosted API and Redwood Dedicated. Redwood Private (on-prem/VPC) is covered for control design; for full coverage we can provide scoped evidence per deployment — happy to discuss specifics. [Link attached: redwood_soc2_report_link.txt]

- Pen test sharing: We provide an executive summary (finding classifications, impact, remediation status) by default. The full technical report is available under a signed NDA and with limited access (redacted where applicable). If FinHealth requires full access, we’ll route through legal — Dev is cc’d to help.

- Vulnerability management & SLAs: 
  * Scanning cadence: weekly automated scans (SAST/DAST where applicable) + monthly dependency scanning + quarterly third-party external tests.
  * Authenticated scans: yes, for our hosted control plane and customer-facing endpoints we run authenticated scans for high-sensitivity customers upon request.
  * Triage & SLAs: Critical (CVSS 9-10) – initial response within 24 hours, remediation or mitigation plan within 72 hours. High (CVSS 7-8.9) – remediation plan within 2 weeks, fix target within 30 days. Medium/low follow standard release cycles.
  * Proof-of-fix: we provide remediation evidence (scan results and/or PRs/patch notes) for critical/high findings.

- Disclosure policy: We follow coordinated disclosure. We’ll provide a timeline and point-of-contact; if you need a custom SLA we can negotiate. See attached vuln_disclosure_policy.docx for details.

I’ve attached a one-page pen test summary from our last quarterly external test (redwood_pen_test_summary_Q2_2026.pdf) that covers categories of findings and remediation status. For access to a full report we’ll need an NDA — Marissa / Dev can kick that off.

If useful, happy to set a short technical call with our security engineer to walk through the questionnaire.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Applied Security
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: redwood_pen_test_summary_Q2_2026.pdf]
[Attachment: vuln_disclosure_policy.docx]
